fabrication.sourceDataRetention: No customer/source rows are committed to the repository. Only source-derived cardinalities and distributions plus the approved source hash are retained.
fabrication.missingAccountExternalId: Create one unique synthetic test account per unresolved opportunity; do not merge unknown accounts.
fabrication.resolvedAccounts: Represent the 125 source-resolved accounts as de-identified deterministic test account slots.
fabrication.ownerId: Use 30 deterministic synthetic owner ids; one owner uses the existing Acceptance A durable test principal.
fabrication.resolvedAccountOwner: Assign resolved account slots round-robin across the 30 synthetic owners because the source file has opportunity sales_agent values, not an independent authoritative account-owner field.
fabrication.tier: Uniform mid_market synthetic default so fabricated tier does not create relative rank differences.
fabrication.lifecycleStage: Generate the source-derived 98 open, 26 customer, and 1 dormant resolved-account shape; every unresolved synthetic account is open_opportunity.
fabrication.employeeCount: Uniform synthetic value 1000 to exercise schema/completeness without affecting current scoring.
fabrication.healthScore: Uniform synthetic value 50 with flat usage and 0 tickets; no relative health ranking bias.
fabrication.amountUsd: Generate deterministic non-negative test amounts; the source had 2635 missing close values on all open opportunities.
fabrication.closeDate: Use one fixed valid test date for closed opportunities; open opportunity close dates remain empty.
fabrication.activities: None fabricated; no fabricated interaction is marked verified.

runtimeMaterialization.internalRecordIds: Deterministic UUIDs derived from generated external ids.
runtimeMaterialization.opportunityProbability: Use the canonical Opportunity schema default (0); probability does not influence current account scoring.
runtimeMaterialization.isClosed: Derived from stage: closed_won or closed_lost => true; otherwise false.
runtimeMaterialization.isWon: Derived from stage: closed_won => true; otherwise false.
